analysis: The only change in this PR is a YAML comment block in docs/threat-model.yaml (head lines 41-48). It records a 2026-11-04 SDK 27.2 Date-comparison review. App Attest key-generation budget, enrollment resume, stall restart and key-history checks now use timeIntervalSince(_:) instead of >= or <=. The comment says this avoids weak-import operators that pre-release macOS 27.2 lacks, which crashed the provider in a loop (an A-018 availability issue). It also says thresholds and results are unchanged, and that release builds refuse binaries importing those symbols via scripts/check-provider-weak-imports.py. I examined the supplied units, TB-007, TB-009, TB-010, TB-011, TB-012, TB-013, T-007 to T-016, T-027 to T-029 and T-041. These are unchanged context, because the diff has no code, trust-boundary, mitigation, severity or status edits. No security regression is introduced by a comment. I verified the comment claims only as documentation; the Swift code change and the weak-import check script are not in the supplied evidence. A reviewer of the companion code should confirm that the timeIntervalSince rewrites preserve boundary semantics (equality cases) for the App Attest budget and freshness checks, since the comment asserts results are unchanged. The comment is not tied to a TB or T entry and does not update the A-018 or T-057 text, which is a minor documentation gap and not a finding. The final TB-007 and T-041 text was supplied, with the T-041 body truncated at line 1389 in the replay.
